facts.text: The module controls Cetoni Nemesys V4 syringe pumps over a serial port
The syringe volume is a constructor option in uL; a second syringe shares the serial object of the first and gets its own node id
A frame is DLE (0x90), STX (0x02), a little-endian payload and a CRC-16, with byte stuffing (DLE doubled)
read() sends opcode 0x60 with node id, object index, subindex and word count
write() sends opcode 0x68 with node id, object index, subindex, word count and a packed value
readCurrentPosition reads 0x6064 and readTargetPosition reads 0x607a as signed 32-bit values; writeTargetPosition writes 0x607a
readVelocity reads 0x6081 and setVelocity accepts only 0 < velocity <= maxProfileVelocity
setFlowRate converts uL/s to the profile velocity register and asserts 0 <= flowRate <= maxVolperS
aspirate applies -volume and dispense +volume; both execute the relative move and wait until the state register reads 1079
The constructor asserts that the safety stop input (bit 28 of digital input 0x60fd) is off
The constructor shuts the drive down with control word 0x06 and enables it with 0x0f through control register 0x6040
toInput calls switchValves(1,0) and toOutput calls switchValves(0,1); switchValves drives 0x60fe and caches the bits in physicalOutputs
The minimum position limit and the safety margin come from 0x607D subindex 1 and subindex 2
The maximum profile velocity is read from 0x607F and maxVolperS is derived from it (maxProfileVelocity*0.001 = maxRPM)
The cross-section is volume/60 (all units mm and uL) and the position conversion factor is encoderResolution*gearFactor

measures.description: Current position in encoder increments (object 0x6064, signed 32-bit)
measures.name: current_position

operator_required.name: target_position
operator_required.reason: the travel range is read from 0x607D at connect (minimum position limit plus safety margin) and depends on the syringe and mechanics; no text states it, so the site sets the range

operator_required.name: velocity
operator_required.reason: the upper bound is the drive's maximum profile velocity, read from 0x607F at connect, and no text of the clone states a numeric velocity range; the site sets the permitted range of its unit

operator_required.name: flow_rate
operator_required.reason: setFlowRate bounds the flow rate by maxVolperS, which is derived at connect from 0x607F and the syringe cross-section (a constructor option); no text states a numeric range, so the site sets it

operator_required.name: pump
operator_required.reason: pump and tubing limits are declared per binding

operator_required.name: pump
operator_required.reason: the usable volume depends on the installed syringe, a constructor option, and no text of the clone states a volume bound; the site sets the range of its syringe

safe_state.description: drive disabled by writing control word 0x06 to control register 0x6040, so motion stops
